column1: # Replikanti/interviewscam#47 fix round 1 (QA's sweep of sentence_folds, the
# code that replaced the 16 INVALID static ids): one row per reading that
# only it holds. R0 alone reads a long s (U+017F) as "s", because the
# skeleton readings take its confusables.txt prototype "f"; with it, a Hangul
# filler (U+3164, a letter the R0 filter would keep) needs R0's invisible
# drop, an accent its NFD, upper case its case fold, and a full-width letter
# its NFKC (the case fold alone handles the long s). A modifier letter w
# (U+02B7) beside a Cyrillic o needs the NFKC inside the skeleton loop, which
# R0, blind to the o, cannot replace. The count rows add two copies of the
# own sentence that differ in which readings hold them: a capital I for an
# l (R1, R3, V1, V3), an i for an l (R3, V3), a Greek capital iota for an i
# (R2, R3, V2, V3), and a right-to-left pair drawn as "lo" with either of
# those (the V readings only); each page counts its sentence 2 times under
# the first reading that deviates and 3 times under R3 or V3, so a reading
# replaced by another names a different count.
